404.description: The server cannot find the requested resource.

version.description: API version to generate from; defaults to the API's current version.

sdkJson.description:
A full custom sdk.json (behavior + per-language emitter options), serialized.
When set it's applied over the derived defaults during generation (the
"wizard" flow); empty → the auto-derived config.

Apitoolchain.AddSdkTargetInput.description: Add a language target to an SDK (kicks off generation).

prefix.description: Public prefix shown in the list to tell keys apart (e.g. `atk_live_a1b2`).

Apitoolchain.ApiKey.description:
A workspace API key. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored; the secret is returned
once, at creation (see CreatedApiKey).

Apitoolchain.AuthSession.description: Login/register response — the opaque session token + the user it belongs to.

apiVersion.description: API version to build every target from; defaults to the API's current.

Apitoolchain.BuildSdkInput.description: Rebuild every target of an SDK from one API spec version.

baseUrl.description: Provider base URL; optional for github.com/gitlab.com, required for self-hosted.

Apitoolchain.ConnectGitProviderInput.description: Connect a git provider (validated via the provider's whoami).

url.description: Registry URL, or a local file-feed path.

token.description: Auth token; may be empty for an anonymous/local registry.

packageName.description: Override the published package name (defaults to the SDK's own name).

Apitoolchain.CreateRegistryConnectionInp.description: Link an SDK target to a package registry.

repo.description: For an existing repo: "owner/name". For a new repo: just the name.

createRepo.description: When true, create `repo` (a name) under the account before connecting.

distTags.description: Comma-separated dist-tags to react to (default `latest`; `*` = all).

Apitoolchain.CreateRepoConnectionInput.description: Link an API spec or SDK target to a repo.

id.description:
Explicit id/slug for the SDK. Slugified server-side; defaults to a slug of
`name`. Lets the display title (`name`) be decoupled from the stable id.

Apitoolchain.CreateSdkInput.description: Create a named SDK for an API.

apiVersion.description: API version to build from; defaults to the API's current.

Apitoolchain.CreateSdkVersionInput.description:
Create a new SDK version: bump the SDK's version and rebuild every target
from one API spec version, recorded as a build in the history.

Apitoolchain.CreatedApiKey.description:
The created key plus its plaintext secret — the ONLY time the secret is
returned. Store it now; it can't be retrieved again.

projects.description: Every project in the current org (for the switcher).

Apitoolchain.DistTag.description:
A named, movable pointer to a version (npm-style). `latest` is auto-managed
(set to the newest version on register); others (`canary`, `beta`, …) are set
by hand. A version ref anywhere may be a concrete version OR a dist-tag name.

Apitoolchain.EntryKind.description: What kind of document a registry entry holds: a full API spec or a schema.

connectedAs.description: The username the token authenticated as (from the provider's whoami).

Apitoolchain.GitProvider.description: A connected git-provider account (the token lives server-side only).

Apitoolchain.GitProviderKind.description: The git platforms the gitprovider service can connect to.

Apitoolchain.GitRepoOption.description: A git repo option surfaced by a provider (for the connect picker).

Apitoolchain.Member.description: A user's membership in the current org.

url.description: Registry URL, or a local file-feed path (maven/nuget/go).

Apitoolchain.PackageRegistry.description: A connected package registry account (token is server-side only).

Apitoolchain.PackageRegistryKind.description: Package registry flavour — the language ecosystem an SDK publishes into.

id.description:
Explicit id/slug for the entry. Slugified server-side; defaults to a slug
of `name`. Lets the display title (`name`) be decoupled from the stable id.

specText.description: Inline spec text (yaml/json/graphql SDL). One of specText | url required.

url.description: URL to fetch the spec from (server-side).

version.description: Explicit version label; defaults to the spec's info.version.

distTag.description:
Dist-tag to publish this version under (default `latest`). `latest` makes
it the current/default version; any other tag (`canary`, `beta`, …) is a
side-channel — added without moving `latest`/current off the stable one.

projectId.description:
The project the API belongs to. Set server-side by the platform gateway
from the caller's current project; defaults to the seeded project.

targetId.description: The SDK target id this connection publishes.

language.description: The target's language (must match the registry kind's ecosystem).

packageName.description: Package name as published (defaults to the SDK's own package name).

autoPublish.description: Publish automatically when a release for this target is merged.

publishLogs.description:
The PUBLISHER's own log (extract → apply name → push → result) — reset each
publish + appended live, so the dashboard can tail it.

Apitoolchain.RegistryConnection.description: Links ONE SDK target (a language) to a package registry it publishes into.

registryUrl.description: Canonical resolvable URL served by registry-api: `/@{ns}/apis/{id}@latest`.

Apitoolchain.RegistryEntry.description: The gateway shape the frontend consumes: core + cross-section rollups.

Apitoolchain.ReleaseState.description: A versioned release cycle for an SDK connection (the rolling PR + its state).

targetId.description: The API id (spec) or SDK target id (sdk) this connection syncs.

ref.description: Optional version/dist-tag ref for spec targets (defaults to current).

prefix.description: Repo subdirectory the files land under (e.g. `specs/` or `sdk/go/`).

releaseMode.description: `push` = legacy direct-push sync; `release` = PR-based release pipeline.

autoRelease.description: Open/force-update a release PR on every new spec version.

baseBranch.description: PR target branch for release mode (distinct from `branch`).

distTags.description:
Comma-separated dist-tags this connection reacts to (default `latest`;
`*` = all).

lastReleasedVersion.description: SDK semver of the last merged release.

Apitoolchain.RepoConnection.description: Links an API spec or SDK target to a repo; `sync` pushes it there.

Apitoolchain.RepoTargetKind.description: What a repo connection syncs into a repo.

Apitoolchain.Sdk.description: A named SDK project tied to one API — a collection of per-language targets.

version.description: The SDK version this build produced.

apiVersion.description: The API spec version every target was built from.

targets.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the targets that went into the build.

logs.description: Accumulated build log — step lines from each target generation.

Apitoolchain.SdkBuild.description:
One SDK build — a produced SDK version, kept as history (the Versions tab).
Regenerates every target from one API spec version; decoupled from each
target's published package version.

name.description:
Human display title, fixed at creation ("<API title> <language>", e.g.
"LiveSession OpenAPI Python") — decoupled from the slug `id` and the
published package name.

sdkId.description: The parent SDK this target belongs to.

apiVersion.description:
The API spec version this target was last built from — decoupled from the
target's own package `version`.

buildLogs.description:
The target's own generation log (`[<lang>] …` lines) — reset each build and
appended live, so the dashboard can tail the current (re)generation.

sdkJson.description:
The custom sdk.json applied at generation (the "wizard" config), serialized;
empty when the target used the auto-derived config.

configPending.description:
The saved sdk.json config has UNBUILT changes — set when the config is edited
(the wizard "Save"), cleared when a build applies it. Drives the persistent
"pending changes, waiting for a build" status in the UI.

Apitoolchain.SetDistTagInput.description: Set (create or move) a dist-tag to point at an existing version.

Apitoolchain.UpdateApiInput.description:
Editable presentation metadata for an existing registry entry. The id/slug,
namespace, format, and kind are IMMUTABLE — they're baked into URLs, the
`apis/<ns>/<api>@<ver>` registry refs, and already-generated SDKs — so only
the display name + description can change (a partial update; omit to keep).

Apitoolchain.User.description: An authenticated account. The password hash never leaves the server.
